prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite sheet for ANUBIS orbital frame from ANUBIS Zone of the Enders. Attached reference is authoritative design. EXACTLY 4 columns x 4 rows of 16 isolated COMPLETE full-body game poses, facing RIGHT in three-quarter side view. Tall slender mechanical jackal-headed mecha, long pointed jackal muzzle and two thin upright ear/antenna spires, small head and long armored legs, black armor with muted golden panels, red glowing eyes/circuits, SIX distinct large metallic vector wings (three on each side of back, white-silver broad blades with black/gold edges), and ONE long segmented black-and-gold mechanical TAIL that curls behind the body. Holds a long thin black/gold Anubis Rod spear, with small red/gold tip. Not a humanoid face, not Jehuty, not an organic furry animal, no extra or missing wings, no missing tail, no giant sword. Premium detailed crisp 2D painted game art matching reference. All six wings, complete tail from root to tip, spear tip, legs and feet must fit safely inside EACH cell with spacious transparent gutters. Transparent background, NO text, labels, grid lines, ground, enemies, background or detached VFX. Cell0 approved idle: stable tall poised standing hover, wings half-open in a fan behind shoulders, tail curves LEFT and its tip curls gently upward, spear held lowered diagonally toward RIGHT. Cells1,2,3 walking-hover cycle with different leg angles, wing blades sweep gradually backward and tail follows in an S curve. Cell4 low crouch wings partially close and tail coils low behind. Cells5,6,7 forward boost run with wings trailing and tail streaming in three distinct bends. Cell8 dash braking pose wings fan out and tail swings forward low. Cell9 turn bank tail curved in opposite direction. Cell10 jump crouch wings tuck and tail coils. Cell11 jump rise wings spread high and tail hangs down. Cell12 rise pose wings angled backward and tail makes shallow S. Cell13 double jump wings expanded wide, legs bent, tail curves down-left. Cell14 airborne poised hover wings relaxed spread and tail curls to left. Cell15 landing crouch wings partly fold, tail lifted behind. Preserve exact anatomy and proportional scale in all cells; draw each whole body, no articulated cut-up parts.

Match attached colors, pointed proportions and six-wing mechanical identity.
